presets.name: Phase 1, small: 40 participants at 4 sites
presets.about: A small early study over 6 months, with every monthly snapshot kept. Quick to open and to look through.

presets.name: Phase 2 oncology: 150 participants at 20 sites
presets.about: The builder's default study, over 9 months, with every layer.

presets.name: Phase 2 virology, many outliers: 200 participants at 25 sites
presets.about: More sites stand out, for trying site metrics and flags. Every monthly snapshot is kept.

presets.name: Phase 3, large: 500 participants at 60 sites
presets.about: The largest study the builder makes, over 12 months. Only its last monthly snapshot is kept: every month would be too large to fetch.

presets.name: CDISC pilot protocol: 16 visits on its schedule of activities
presets.about: Read from the pilot study's CDISC USDM file. Visits, vital signs and labs follow the protocol's schedule of activities. Bilirubin is added to its chemistry panel, which the file's lab list leaves out. ADAS-Cog (11) is simulated by arm: the 3.0 difference and 6.5 standard deviation are the protocol's own sample size sentence; the rest are ours.
